adjudication: The B12 storage-only B1HCI exception is caused by floating-point loss of the exact linear water invariant during repeated float64 state accumulation.
Ordinary final summation order is not the cause: np.sum versus math.fsum is about three orders of magnitude smaller than the invariant drift.

Increasing only state-accumulation precision, while keeping the same float64 constitutive/RHS evaluation and the same hydrological closure, reduces storage and invariant errors by more than two orders of magnitude.
The B12 exception therefore does not justify a new hydrological state, partition or closure.
